gen-fs-bevellier-gf-open-sans: Flat, stencil-cut and tightly spaced, Bevellier carries a graceful look up top. Open Sans lets paragraphs run smooth and unclogged, its bulky lowercase carrying the text along without any strain.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-orienta: Orienta lets its counters breathe and keeps capitals and lowercase close in height, a modern and neutral voice. And Bevellier, flat and stencil-cut with no brush-style pressure swell anywhere, gives it a graceful, tight-set headline.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-oxygen: Thread-stitched strokes and a flat, stencil-cut finish. Bevellier is made for graceful display, tightly spaced and wide-looking, while the sans-serif Oxygen keeps curves open and lowercase nearly level with the capitals.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-parkinsans: Sophisticated and graceful, Bevellier arrives flat, stencil-cut and tightly spaced. Parkinsans follows with one stroke thickness throughout and wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp when shrunk, leaving the heading room to lead.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-pathway-extreme: Thread-plain strokes make Bevellier look flat and stencil-cut. Pathway Extreme then settles into text with clear openings in its rounded letters and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height, so paragraphs read cleanly.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-preahvihear: Tight and stencil-cut, Bevellier carries no vertical emphasis and no horizontal thinning, just graceful single-weight lines. Preahvihear brings the real lift, with open letter mouths and a lofty x-height.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-prompt: Ruler-straight and stencil-cut, Bevellier looks graceful, with letters packed tightly and a wide-looking lowercase. Then Prompt takes over, its oversized small letters and open apertures keeping text approachable from line to line.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-pt-sans-caption: PT Sans Caption brings big-bodied lowercase and inviting, unclosed bowls, a counter to the nib-drawn, tightly spaced Bevellier. Text in it feels welcoming and unhurried, with a professional finish.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-puritan: Puritan rounds its forms and keeps them open to the side, with big counters in e and a. Bevellier, flat and pipe-bodied with tight spacing, supplies the graceful headline note.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-questrial: Questrial feels modern and professional, with a tall band of letters topped by short stalks. So paragraphs of this sans move along easily, leaving Bevellier to carry the graceful tone.
